summary: Attack cases (a), (b), and (c) hold. All seven tutor-commission K files are unchanged in the phase range. The D4 gate is correct for its commit: 0d705612d deleted the full navigation it.each block (3 cases, 6 total), and 9eb3b9c4f restored the th/zh supported-locale cases under Review A finding F6, which exercise the real routing.locales branch. No e2e file is counted. Anti-patterns A1, A3, A4, A5, A7, A8 hold. Both new fixtures hold against ten committed hostile probes. ADV-1 withdrawn on the contest evidence; ADV-2 remains a nit.
nonblocking_findings: ADV-2 [Nit] adversarial: no coverage log carries a literal line_coverage_pct= label line. The label lives in the gate JSON files, and each log holds the istanbul 'Lines : NN.NN%' summary. Every gate value matches its log summary (spot-checked 407c5d9: 90.03), so the A3 defense holds in substance.
evidence: ADV-1 withdrawn: git show 0d705612d on navigation.test.tsx deletes the whole it.each(['en','th','zh']) block, so the D4 commit removed 6 cases and gate-0d705612.json is correct for that commit; the cumulative range diff misread the restore as a partial deletion.

ADV-1 withdrawn: git show 9eb3b9c4f restores it.each(['th','zh']) under Review A round 1 finding F6 of review-a-c673f21.json, and plan.md task 2.7 records the remediation round A fix commits 733319505, fb5622ed7, 9eb3b9c4f.

ADV-1 withdrawn: useCurrentLocale in src/locales/navigation.ts reads routing.locales and returns the default only for an unsupported locale, so the restored th/zh cases fail a hook that always returns the default.
git diff on the seven tutor-commission K files across a1caa5803..bfda22bd8 is empty (exit 0, no output).
vitest list at bfda22bd8 shows src/locales/navigation.test.tsx runs 3 cases: returns the active th locale, returns the active zh locale, uses the configured default for an unsupported locale.
grep -a -E 'Tests  ' on green-e332f594.log shows 3146 passed and on green-0d705612.log shows 3140 passed; neither log contains a skip line.
grep -c line_coverage_pct over all coverage-*.log files returns 0; tail of coverage-407c5d9.log shows 'Lines : 90.03%', equal to gate-407c5d9.json line_coverage_pct.
baseline.json line_coverage_pct=86.52 and every gate floor is 85.52, the baseline minus 1 point; every gate line_coverage_pct is 89.86 to 90.94.
green-at-7008ccef.log reports 89 files and 3081 tests passed, matching gate-7008ccef.json cases_after=3081 (F10 remediation holds).
per-file-counts.md contains no e2e row, and classification.md lists all six e2e files as not counted.
Both fixture probes pass: 10 of 10 in locale-key-check.adversarial.test.ts and real-css.adversarial.test.ts at commit bfda22bd8.
The phase-range diff under apps/ names test files and test fixtures only; no production file changed.

Ten committed adversarial probes pass at bfda22bd8, and Review A rounds hold breakage proofs for the restored and rewritten checks.
The phase-range diff under apps/ names test files and fixtures only; no production file changed.
Every count, coverage value, and deletion claim now has a command result behind it, including the git show evidence that closed ADV-1.
